result.reason: The new language meets the fallback by providing 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day non-renewal deadline, and a fee increase cap below 5%. It does not meet the preferred automatic-renewal position because it omits the Vendor’s 60-day reminder. The edit is not minimal or cleanly drafted because existing Sections II and III still require mutual written agreement for extensions, directly conflicting with the new automatic-renewal mechanism; Section II also retains the defective phrase “mutual written of the parties.” Unrelated termination rights remain unchanged.
